jobs.title: Enterprise Program Leader / Leader de programme d’entreprise - Montreal
jobs.description:
English follows* 

Slalom est un cabinet de conseil en technologie et en stratégie résolument humain. Nous sommes orientés résultats et on cherche toujours à créer de la valeur, sous toutes ses formes. De la stratégie jusqu’à la livraison, nos équipes agiles — présentes dans 52 bureaux à travers 12 pays — travaillent main dans la main avec nos clients pour co-créer des expériences client marquantes, des façons de travailler plus modernes et un impact durable et concret.

Ce qui nous démarque ? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et valorisant — pas parfait, mais possible. C’est pour ça qu’on met le bon sens, la flexibilité, les relations humaines et la reconnaissance au cœur de nos priorités, pour que nos équipes puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’elles font…  la plupart du temps .

Rôle: 

Leader de programme d’entreprise – Salesforce

Alors, quel sera mon r
ôle
?

Aider à bâtir une équipe afin d’influencer, d’habiliter et de faire évoluer nos rôles et équipes de livraison à l’échelle de Slalom, afin d’assurer une livraison cohérente et de grande qualité.
Diriger les efforts visant à instaurer une continuité dans la gestion des engagements Salesforce et dans la méthodologie de livraison pour l’ensemble des praticiens Salesforce à l’échelle mondiale.
Piloter les initiatives de capture des meilleures pratiques et le développement d’études de cas et d’autres livrables clés afin de bâtir des offres de solutions.
Influencer la description de poste, les qualifications et la marque des praticiens en excellence de livraison.
Interagir directement avec les cadres supérieurs des clients à titre de cadre responsable (Accountable Executive) et/ou de responsable d’engagement sur nos mandats les plus transformationnels, en veillant à ce que les leaders de livraison soient bien outillés pour gérer les risques d’engagement, les finances de projet, les comptes clients, la définition des livrables et l’adhésion des hauts dirigeants du client aux solutions proposées.
Assurer la supervision de projets et programmes de livraison logicielle complexes et de grande envergure chez les clients.
Travailler avec les équipes locales afin d’assurer l’adoption réussie des méthodologies de livraison.
Établir des relations collaboratives à travers Slalom, incluant les équipes de direction locales, Build et les autres lignes d’affaires.
Fournir de l’orientation, du coaching, du mentorat et un encadrement quotidien à une équipe de collaborateurs directs sur un ou plusieurs projets; gérer la rétroaction sur la performance et les processus d’évaluation annuelle.
Offrir une expertise et diriger les opportunités de développement des affaires, y compris la rédaction d’énoncés de travaux (SOW) et la présentation de solutions à des clients potentiels.
Agir à titre de gestionnaire de personnel pour les membres de l’équipe de leadership des programmes Salesforce d’entreprise et offrir un mentorat et des conseils significatifs aux membres de la pratique.
Établir des relations collaboratives à travers Slalom, incluant les équipes de direction locales, Build et les autres lignes d’affaires.
Soutenir le recrutement, la sélection, l’affectation et l’intégration des consultants aux projets; contribuer à la qualification des opportunités et collaborer avec les gestionnaires de personnel et les consultants afin d’évaluer l’adéquation des projets.
Promouvoir et influencer le développement des employés et des leaders, et créer des occasions d’évolution de carrière.

Et, qu'est-ce que j'apporterai à l’organisation?

Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en consultation dans des rôles de leadership en livraison liés au développement logiciel itératif, notamment comme leader de programme, responsable d’engagement ou rôles similaires à la tête de projets complexes.
Plus de 3 ans d’expérience dans la vente et la livraison de solutions d’affaires sur la plateforme Salesforce; capacité démontrée à expliquer les approches de livraison et les considérations selon la taille et l’envergure des projets et des clients, à travers les différents nuages Salesforce.
Expérience dans toutes les phases du développement de produits, du développement logiciel et des cycles de tests.
Expérience dans la gestion de départements technologiques et de produits bien établis, avec des processus et standards de gestion de programme matures, tant en méthodologies Agile qu’en cascade (Waterfall).
Expérience en recrutement et en constitution d’équipes; expérience reconnue en gestion avec un solide historique de mentorat.
Croissance professionnelle démontrée et capacité éprouvée à travailler de façon transversale.
Familiarité avec les outils et processus de gouvernance de livraison et de suivi de statut afin de soutenir la supervision et l’assurance qualité d’un portefeuille de projets mondiaux.
Historique démontré dans la rédaction de demandes de propositions (RFP) et d’énoncés de travaux (SOW), ainsi que dans la révision de propositions avec les clients et la négociation de contrats.
Expertise en opérations d’affaires (p. ex. facturation, SOW, marges, taux d’utilisation).
Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, auprès d’auditoires de tous niveaux, incluant des compétences en communication avec les clients.
Expertise en méthodologies agiles de livraison logicielle : Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, XP et Lean.
Passion pour la création de solutions Salesforce et d’autres solutions logicielles utilisant des technologies de pointe.
Capacité à relever des défis et plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes.
Expertise en livraison de projets, incluant tous les aspects de la gestion de programme et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC).
Excellentes compétences en communication (orale et écrite).
Excellentes aptitudes en mentorat et en leadership. 

Hybride / En présentiel : Nous fonctionnons en mode hybride, mais il est attendu que vous puissiez vous rendre sur site lorsque votre chef d’équipe ou un client l’exige.

Avantages pour nos employés:

Culture et Divertissement! 

Dîner-Causerie 
Activités dédiées à la santé et au bien-être 
Célébrations de fin d’année 
Les Groupes Communautaires des Employés
Club social et activités 
Vacances (20 jours au prorata de la date d’embauche & jours de bien-être/maladie)  

Avantages 

Rémunération compétitive 
100$ d’allocation mensuelle pour cellulaire sous forme de remboursement 
Régime Enregistré d’Épargne Retraite (REER) collectif & cotisation employeur 
Compte d’Épargne Libre d’Impôt (CELI) 
Carte cadeau annuel pour le bien être « Thrive » 
Planification familiale / fécondité 
Salaire complémentaire pour congé maternité/parental 
Assurance Médicale et Dentaire 
Assurance Vie et Assurance en Cas de Décès ou de Mutilation par Accident 
Accès à une couverture supplémentaire d’Assurance Vie et Assurance en Cas de Décès ou de Mutilation par Accident 
Programme d’Aide aux Employés (PAE) et « Inkblot Therapy » 
Et plus ! 

*Tous les avantages sont soumis à l’admissibilité des participants aux prestations. 

Slalom est un employeur inclusif valorisant l’égalité des chances et engagé à la création d’une main-d’œuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons à bras ouverts les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et travaillerons à accommoder raisonnablement les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement et de sélection. Veuillez communiquer avec l’équipe d’acquisition de talents si vous nécessitez des accommodements lors du processus d’entrevue.   

Veuillez noter que si vous êtes embauché(e) chez Slalom, vous devrez remplir une vérification des antécédents. 

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.

At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Job Title: 
Enterprise Program Leader - Salesforce
﻿
So, what will I do?

•            Help build a team to influence, enable, and scale our delivery roles and teams across Slalom to ensure consistent and high-quality delivery.
•           Lead efforts to bring continuity to our Salesforce engagement management and delivery methodology to all Salesforce practitioners globally.
•           Lead the efforts to capture best practices and develop case studies and other core deliverables to build solution offerings
•           Influence the job description, qualifications, and brand of Delivery Excellence practitioners.
•           Engage directly with senior client stakeholders as an Accountable Executive and/or Engagement Lead on our most transformational engagements, ensuring delivery leaders are set up to manage engagement risk, project financials, accounts receivable, defining deliverable content, and ensuring buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client.
•           Perform oversight of large-scale, complex software delivery project/program management on client engagements.
•           Work with local teams to ensure successful adoption of delivery methodology.
•           Build collaborative relationships across Slalom, including local market leadership, Build, and other lines of business.
•           Provide guidance, coaching, mentoring, and day-to-day direction for a team of direct reports on a project(s); handle the performance feedback and annual review processes for direct reports.
•           Provide expert guidance and lead business development opportunities, including writing SOWs and presenting solutions to perspective clients.
•           Serve as a People Manager for people within Enterprise Salesforce Program Leadership team and provide meaningful mentoring and advising to members of the capability.
•           Build collaborative relationships across Slalom, including local market leadership, Build, and other lines of business.
•           Support recruitment, selection, staffing and onboarding of consultants to projects; assist in qualifying opportunities and work with people managers and consultants to assess project fit.
•           Promote and influence employee and leader development and create opportunities for career progression.
•           70% target utilization at the designated enterprise client account.

•           8+ years of consulting experience in delivery leadership relative to iterative software development as a Program Lead, Engagement Lead, and similar roles leading complex projects

•           Experience in all phases of product development, software development, and testing lifecycles

jobs.title: Senior Director, Governance and Execution Oversight
jobs.description:
The Senior Director, Governance & Execution Oversight, Global Risk Intelligence and Technology (GRIT) is responsible for driving execution discipline, governance effectiveness, adoption management, and value realization across Global Risk transformation initiatives in AI, Data and Technology. The role serves as a key partner in Global Risk Technology and Intelligence governance, translating strategic priorities into executable workstreams while ensuring governance decisions result in measurable business outcomes.

This position will oversee intake and prioritization processes, establish operating frameworks and governance disciplines, and define the metrics and reporting needed to measure adoption, benefits realization, capacity utilization, and portfolio performance.

The role acts as a critical link between strategy, governance, execution, and sustained business value realization across the Global Risk portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Transformation Governance & Strategic Execution

Partner with senior leaders to translate approved priorities into executable workstream plans.
Establish and maintain governance processes supporting prioritization, intake, qualification, approval, and execution oversight.
Drive accountability and follow-through on decisions arising from governance forums.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment of delivery plans, dependencies, milestones, and outcomes.
Monitor execution progress and escalate delivery risks, constraints, or resource challenges.

Portfolio Management & Prioritization

Support development and administration of portfolio intake, assessment, and prioritization frameworks.
Evaluate transformation opportunities against strategic objectives, capacity constraints, risk considerations, and value criteria.
Facilitate portfolio planning processes and support leadership decision-making.
Maintain visibility into transformation demand, delivery capacity, investment priorities, and execution status.
Develop and implement portfolio reporting and performance management practices.

Adoption & Value Realization

Define and implement measurement frameworks for technology, automation, AI, and Data transformation initiatives.
Establish and report on key performance indicators measuring adoption, utilization, business outcomes, benefits realization, and operational effectiveness.
Develop methodologies for measuring product value, customer value, business impact, and sustained adoption.
Monitor trends and identify opportunities to improve user adoption and business outcomes.
Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, and transformation leaders to address adoption barriers and optimize value realization.

Operating Model & Process Excellence

Design and formalize governance operating models supporting transformation management and execution oversight.
Develop and maintain RASCIs, Standard Operating Procedures, playbooks, operating frameworks, qualification frameworks, intake processes, and governance documentation.
Establish repeatable and scalable operating practices across transformation portfolios.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve governance effectiveness and execution efficiency.

Reporting, Insights & Performance Management

Establish and execute recurring reporting cycles covering adoption performance, benefits realization, capacity utilization, portfolio performance, transformation progress, and product value realization.
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting for executive audiences.
Generate actionable insights supporting portfolio optimization and strategic decision-making.
Track and communicate transformation outcomes to senior leadership.

Stakeholder & Executive Engagement

Build strong relationships with executives, product owners, transformation leads, and business stakeholders.
Support leadership decision-making through structured governance, analysis, and reporting.
Facilitate alignment across teams involved in transformation delivery and adoption activities.
Present recommendations, portfolio insights, and performance updates to leadership forums.
Promote a culture of accountability, adoption, continuous improvement, and outcomes-based delivery.

Qualifications

Education

University degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Information Technology, Organizational Change, or a related field.
Professional certifications such as CPA, PMP, Agile, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, CBAP, or equivalent are considered an asset.

Experience

8+ years of progressive experience supporting large-scale business transformation, strategic execution, portfolio governance, program management, organizational effectiveness, or technology adoption initiatives.
Experience working with executive governance forums and senior leadership teams.
Experience developing performance reporting, operational metrics, dashboards, and value realization frameworks.
Experience driving cross-functional initiatives across complex organizations.
Financial services, risk management, compliance, governance, or transformation office experience preferred.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Solutions - Google Cloud
jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone)
.

THE ROLE:

As Director, Enterprise Solutions - Google Cloud, you'll drive how Apply Digital shapes, sells, and delivers complex cloud and AI solutions on Google Cloud for enterprise clients. Reporting into the VP, Enterprise Solutions, you'll bridge technical architecture, business strategy, and go-to-market execution. You'll be a hands-on architect and trusted technology advisor to client executives while driving co-sell engagement with Google Cloud's partner engineering, product, and field sales teams. You'll also help build and grow Apply Digital's internal Google Cloud community of practitioners, helping enterprise organizations use Gemini, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and cloud-native platforms to create meaningful business value and competitive advantage.

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Solution Architecture

Shape and execute the technology vision for enterprise clients on Google Cloud, aligning AI, data, and modernization solutions with business objectives and transformation goals
Lead and personally contribute to the design and architecture of complex, enterprise-level solutions using Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI, BigQuery, AlloyDB, GKE, and Cloud Run
Provide technical leadership and guidance on architecture best practices, emerging technologies, and industry trends
Design next-generation agentic and generative AI solutions, including RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, and Gemini Enterprise implementations
Define architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, resilience, and long-term value, including composable and API-first approaches where they fit

Client Relationship Management

Act as a trusted technology advisor to client executives and senior stakeholders
Build CFO-ready TCO and ROI models comparing on-premise, multi-cloud, and Google Cloud unit economics
Lead discovery sessions, architecture reviews, solution design workshops, and technical presentations to align stakeholders on solution vision and approach
Proactively identify opportunities to deliver additional value and expand Apply Digital's footprint within accounts

Pre-Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth

Own pre-sales execution for assigned enterprise pursuits, including discovery, solution design, and proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements
Partner with Apply Digital sellers and Google Cloud account teams to co-sell solutions, carrying a personal pipeline generation and revenue influence goal
Produce RFP responses, Statements of Work, and technical proposals with explicit assumptions, bounded scope, and risk frameworks that protect delivery margins
Use modern AI tools to speed up documentation, proposal drafting, and estimation without sacrificing engineering rigor

Google Cloud Ecosystem & GTM Alignment

Build and maintain strong relationships with Google Cloud Partner Engineers, Product Managers, and Field Sales to maximize joint deal routing and co-sell priority
Contribute to and participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and joint account planning to align Apply Digital's offerings with Google Cloud's strategic priorities, such as Data, Generative AI, and Modernization
Represent Apply Digital at Google Cloud Next, industry events, webinars, and partner panels

Solution Productization & Practice IP

Identify high-value patterns across engagements and help package them into repeatable offerings, accelerators, reference architectures, and pricing models
Develop reusable estimation models, discovery frameworks, and PoC templates that raise the technical output of the broader team
Help build and grow Apply Digital's internal Google Cloud community of practice

Technical Delivery & Project Oversight

Provide delivery leadership for the Google Cloud engagements you shape, ensuring they meet client requirements, quality standards, and business outcomes
Guide technical teams through complex implementation challenges and ensure adherence to Google Cloud best practices

Team Leadership & Development

Mentor and coach junior and mid-level architects on technical design, ecosystem navigation, and commercial pre-sales discipline
Support Google Cloud certification and delivery enablement across the technology team
Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and retention of top Google Cloud talent

Requirements

10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, enterprise solution architecture, or technical consulting in a professional services environment, with at least 2 years in a leadership role
3+ years of dedicated experience in the Google Cloud ecosystem in a customer- and partner-facing capacity
Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification
Proven pre-sales track record, including shaping complex technical deals, writing SOWs, and partnering with sales teams to hit revenue targets
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex solutions for large-scale enterprise clients
Experience working in digital agencies, strategic consultancies, or systems integrators delivering client-facing solutions
Deep, hands-on expertise in modern cloud architectures, database systems (BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud Spanner), and containerization platforms (GKE, Cloud Run)
Hands-on production experience with modern AI stacks, such as Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, agentic workflows, or RAG pipelines
Ability to build CFO-ready TCO and ROI models
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage executives, technical stakeholders, and Google Cloud partner teams
Experience mentoring and developing technical team members
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes pursuits and client relationships at once
Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort navigating ambiguity and solving complex problems

Nice to Have

Additional Google Cloud certifications (Professional Data Engineer, Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or Professional Machine Learning Engineer)
Deep understanding of Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, and Google's generative media offerings
Vertical experience in CPG, Retail, Media, or Entertainment
Experience with commerce platforms, content management systems, and digital experience platforms
Knowledge of agile methodologies and experience leading agile delivery teams
Public speaking experience and thought leadership contributions to the technology or Google Cloud community

$150,000 - $220,000 a year

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

jobs.title: Managing Director, Investment Fund Finance
jobs.description:
At ATB, we exist to make it possible for our clients, team members and communities. Our purpose is more than aspirational. It's a real commitment we live every day through our values (what we call the ATB ID).

About

Life at ATB is about more than work. In fact, we’re consistently recognized as one of Canada's top employers thanks to our high-care, high-performance culture, upheld by the three commitments we make to our team members:

Impact in action:
No matter where you are in the organization, you're empowered to make an impact in the lives of our clients and communities.

Thrive together:
We want you—the unique, authentic you—to feel safe and celebrated at work. We're on a continuous journey to build the most flexible and inclusive programs.

Ready for tomorrow:
We want to enable your success through interesting and challenging work, performance enablement, and learning and development.

Leadership is in our DNA at ATB, reflecting our commitment to developing world-class leaders who can truly thrive. Our Leader DNA model sets the standard for how we lead people, drive business performance, and shape a dynamic future. This is the place for purpose-driven individuals ready to deliver impactful leadership every day.

About The Role

Responsible for the management and oversight in the delivery of financial, regulatory, tax, performance reporting requirements in support of the investment products manufactured by ATB Investment Management Inc. (“ATBIM”). This role leads the investment fund finance team in managing day to day responsibilities that encompass ongoing fund administration and the financial reporting and audit cycles.

Accountabilities

Responsible for annual and semi-annual financial and regulatory reporting and audit cycles for ATBIM’s investment products.
Oversees the Investment Fund Finance team and all day to day fund accounting, valuations, performance and reporting requirements.
Oversee all tax compliance for ATB Funds, including year-end and ad-hoc distribution process, liaise with fund administrator, external tax advisors, accounting and operations teams.
Ensures financial processes are performed in accordance with internal and operational controls, proactively identifying opportunities for improvements.
Management and oversight of ATBIM’s third party service providers (custodian, administrators, auditors), monitoring service level agreements and accuracy of deliverables and adherence to all regulatory standards
Participate in strategic initiatives and projects including product development and launch, implementation of tools and technology to enhance ATBIM’s investment management capabilities
Leads the Investment Fund Finance team through performance planning and assessment, coaching, developmental planning and resolution of escalated issues to ensure effective performance of the team
Collaborate internally with ATBIM leadership team and ATB Financial teams (Finance, Internal Assurance, Third Party Risk Management, Legal, etc).

Skills, Experience & Requirements

CPA or equivalent professional designation required
10-15+ years of progressive experience in the investment industry
Tax training and experience considered a strong asset
Subject matter expertise in industry rules and regulations, along with a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory landscape and proposed changes.
Progressive leadership experience with the ability to motivate, coach and develop a high performing team
Ability to engage teams across divisions, develop collaborative relationships and coordinate effectively to come to a mutual understanding to achieve aligned goals.
Highly developed problem solving skills and professional judgment in handling complex or unexpected situations objectively by assessing situations, identifying and weighing alternative options, and making data-driven recommendations to solve problems.
Ability to anticipate and identify business and regulatory issues, and deliver creative solutions and opportunities for improvements.
Ability to work under pressure to manage competing and often time-sensitive priorities and deadlines with a high degree of ownership and accountability

Salary Range

$170,000 - $185,0000

Don’t meet all the requirements on the list?

A resume only goes so far in expressing who you are and the unique perspectives you bring. If you believe your skills and experience align with the role—but you might not check all the boxes—we want to hear from you. We encourage candidates from all work backgrounds, equity-seeking communities and experience levels to apply. If you’re seeking a career where your drive, perspective and growth are celebrated, we want to hear from you.

We’re dedicated to building a workforce reflective of those within our communities, and a culture where our team members are equipped with what they need to succeed—their way. Part of creating an inclusive workplace is recognizing our role in advancing Truth and Reconciliation. We are committed to meeting and exceeding the standards set out in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations program created by the Canadian Council for Aboriginal Business.

What happens next?

If you are shortlisted, you’ll hear from us after the posting closes. Check out our How We Hire page to learn more about our hiring process. If you need any accommodations throughout this process, please let us know at talentteam@atb.com

Stay in touch

We’re excited that you’re interested in a career with ATB. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to learn more about what our team is up to.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Program Leader / Leader de programme d’entreprise - Montreal
new_jobs.description:
English follows* 

Slalom est un cabinet de conseil en technologie et en stratégie résolument humain. Nous sommes orientés résultats et on cherche toujours à créer de la valeur, sous toutes ses formes. De la stratégie jusqu’à la livraison, nos équipes agiles — présentes dans 52 bureaux à travers 12 pays — travaillent main dans la main avec nos clients pour co-créer des expériences client marquantes, des façons de travailler plus modernes et un impact durable et concret.

Ce qui nous démarque ? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et valorisant — pas parfait, mais possible. C’est pour ça qu’on met le bon sens, la flexibilité, les relations humaines et la reconnaissance au cœur de nos priorités, pour que nos équipes puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’elles font…  la plupart du temps .

Rôle: 

Leader de programme d’entreprise – Salesforce

Alors, quel sera mon r
ôle
?

Aider à bâtir une équipe afin d’influencer, d’habiliter et de faire évoluer nos rôles et équipes de livraison à l’échelle de Slalom, afin d’assurer une livraison cohérente et de grande qualité.
Diriger les efforts visant à instaurer une continuité dans la gestion des engagements Salesforce et dans la méthodologie de livraison pour l’ensemble des praticiens Salesforce à l’échelle mondiale.
Piloter les initiatives de capture des meilleures pratiques et le développement d’études de cas et d’autres livrables clés afin de bâtir des offres de solutions.
Influencer la description de poste, les qualifications et la marque des praticiens en excellence de livraison.
Interagir directement avec les cadres supérieurs des clients à titre de cadre responsable (Accountable Executive) et/ou de responsable d’engagement sur nos mandats les plus transformationnels, en veillant à ce que les leaders de livraison soient bien outillés pour gérer les risques d’engagement, les finances de projet, les comptes clients, la définition des livrables et l’adhésion des hauts dirigeants du client aux solutions proposées.
Assurer la supervision de projets et programmes de livraison logicielle complexes et de grande envergure chez les clients.
Travailler avec les équipes locales afin d’assurer l’adoption réussie des méthodologies de livraison.
Établir des relations collaboratives à travers Slalom, incluant les équipes de direction locales, Build et les autres lignes d’affaires.
Fournir de l’orientation, du coaching, du mentorat et un encadrement quotidien à une équipe de collaborateurs directs sur un ou plusieurs projets; gérer la rétroaction sur la performance et les processus d’évaluation annuelle.
Offrir une expertise et diriger les opportunités de développement des affaires, y compris la rédaction d’énoncés de travaux (SOW) et la présentation de solutions à des clients potentiels.
Agir à titre de gestionnaire de personnel pour les membres de l’équipe de leadership des programmes Salesforce d’entreprise et offrir un mentorat et des conseils significatifs aux membres de la pratique.
Établir des relations collaboratives à travers Slalom, incluant les équipes de direction locales, Build et les autres lignes d’affaires.
Soutenir le recrutement, la sélection, l’affectation et l’intégration des consultants aux projets; contribuer à la qualification des opportunités et collaborer avec les gestionnaires de personnel et les consultants afin d’évaluer l’adéquation des projets.
Promouvoir et influencer le développement des employés et des leaders, et créer des occasions d’évolution de carrière.

Et, qu'est-ce que j'apporterai à l’organisation?

Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en consultation dans des rôles de leadership en livraison liés au développement logiciel itératif, notamment comme leader de programme, responsable d’engagement ou rôles similaires à la tête de projets complexes.
Plus de 3 ans d’expérience dans la vente et la livraison de solutions d’affaires sur la plateforme Salesforce; capacité démontrée à expliquer les approches de livraison et les considérations selon la taille et l’envergure des projets et des clients, à travers les différents nuages Salesforce.
Expérience dans toutes les phases du développement de produits, du développement logiciel et des cycles de tests.
Expérience dans la gestion de départements technologiques et de produits bien établis, avec des processus et standards de gestion de programme matures, tant en méthodologies Agile qu’en cascade (Waterfall).
Expérience en recrutement et en constitution d’équipes; expérience reconnue en gestion avec un solide historique de mentorat.
Croissance professionnelle démontrée et capacité éprouvée à travailler de façon transversale.
Familiarité avec les outils et processus de gouvernance de livraison et de suivi de statut afin de soutenir la supervision et l’assurance qualité d’un portefeuille de projets mondiaux.
Historique démontré dans la rédaction de demandes de propositions (RFP) et d’énoncés de travaux (SOW), ainsi que dans la révision de propositions avec les clients et la négociation de contrats.
Expertise en opérations d’affaires (p. ex. facturation, SOW, marges, taux d’utilisation).
Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, auprès d’auditoires de tous niveaux, incluant des compétences en communication avec les clients.
Expertise en méthodologies agiles de livraison logicielle : Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, XP et Lean.
Passion pour la création de solutions Salesforce et d’autres solutions logicielles utilisant des technologies de pointe.
Capacité à relever des défis et plaisir à résoudre des problèmes complexes.
Expertise en livraison de projets, incluant tous les aspects de la gestion de programme et du cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC).
Excellentes compétences en communication (orale et écrite).
Excellentes aptitudes en mentorat et en leadership. 

Hybride / En présentiel : Nous fonctionnons en mode hybride, mais il est attendu que vous puissiez vous rendre sur site lorsque votre chef d’équipe ou un client l’exige.

Avantages pour nos employés:

Culture et Divertissement! 

Dîner-Causerie 
Activités dédiées à la santé et au bien-être 
Célébrations de fin d’année 
Les Groupes Communautaires des Employés
Club social et activités 
Vacances (20 jours au prorata de la date d’embauche & jours de bien-être/maladie)  

Avantages 

Rémunération compétitive 
100$ d’allocation mensuelle pour cellulaire sous forme de remboursement 
Régime Enregistré d’Épargne Retraite (REER) collectif & cotisation employeur 
Compte d’Épargne Libre d’Impôt (CELI) 
Carte cadeau annuel pour le bien être « Thrive » 
Planification familiale / fécondité 
Salaire complémentaire pour congé maternité/parental 
Assurance Médicale et Dentaire 
Assurance Vie et Assurance en Cas de Décès ou de Mutilation par Accident 
Accès à une couverture supplémentaire d’Assurance Vie et Assurance en Cas de Décès ou de Mutilation par Accident 
Programme d’Aide aux Employés (PAE) et « Inkblot Therapy » 
Et plus ! 

*Tous les avantages sont soumis à l’admissibilité des participants aux prestations. 

Slalom est un employeur inclusif valorisant l’égalité des chances et engagé à la création d’une main-d’œuvre diversifiée. Nous accueillons à bras ouverts les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et travaillerons à accommoder raisonnablement les candidats tout au long du processus de recrutement et de sélection. Veuillez communiquer avec l’équipe d’acquisition de talents si vous nécessitez des accommodements lors du processus d’entrevue.   

Veuillez noter que si vous êtes embauché(e) chez Slalom, vous devrez remplir une vérification des antécédents. 

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries collaborate with clients to bring powerful customer experiences, innovative ways of working, and new products and services to life. We are trusted by leaders across the Global 1000, many successful enterprise and mid-market companies, and 500+ public sector organizations to improve operations, drive growth, and create value.

At Slalom, we believe that together, we can move faster, dream bigger, and build better tomorrows for all.

Job Title: 
Enterprise Program Leader - Salesforce
﻿
So, what will I do?

•            Help build a team to influence, enable, and scale our delivery roles and teams across Slalom to ensure consistent and high-quality delivery.
•           Lead efforts to bring continuity to our Salesforce engagement management and delivery methodology to all Salesforce practitioners globally.
•           Lead the efforts to capture best practices and develop case studies and other core deliverables to build solution offerings
•           Influence the job description, qualifications, and brand of Delivery Excellence practitioners.
•           Engage directly with senior client stakeholders as an Accountable Executive and/or Engagement Lead on our most transformational engagements, ensuring delivery leaders are set up to manage engagement risk, project financials, accounts receivable, defining deliverable content, and ensuring buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client.

•           Promote and influence employee and leader development and create opportunities for career progression.

new_jobs.title: Managing Director, Investment Fund Finance
new_jobs.description:
At ATB, we exist to make it possible for our clients, team members and communities. Our purpose is more than aspirational. It's a real commitment we live every day through our values (what we call the ATB ID).

About

Life at ATB is about more than work. In fact, we’re consistently recognized as one of Canada's top employers thanks to our high-care, high-performance culture, upheld by the three commitments we make to our team members:

Impact in action:
No matter where you are in the organization, you're empowered to make an impact in the lives of our clients and communities.

Thrive together:
We want you—the unique, authentic you—to feel safe and celebrated at work. We're on a continuous journey to build the most flexible and inclusive programs.

Ready for tomorrow:
We want to enable your success through interesting and challenging work, performance enablement, and learning and development.

Leadership is in our DNA at ATB, reflecting our commitment to developing world-class leaders who can truly thrive. Our Leader DNA model sets the standard for how we lead people, drive business performance, and shape a dynamic future. This is the place for purpose-driven individuals ready to deliver impactful leadership every day.

About The Role

Responsible for the management and oversight in the delivery of financial, regulatory, tax, performance reporting requirements in support of the investment products manufactured by ATB Investment Management Inc. (“ATBIM”). This role leads the investment fund finance team in managing day to day responsibilities that encompass ongoing fund administration and the financial reporting and audit cycles.

Accountabilities

Responsible for annual and semi-annual financial and regulatory reporting and audit cycles for ATBIM’s investment products.
Oversees the Investment Fund Finance team and all day to day fund accounting, valuations, performance and reporting requirements.
Oversee all tax compliance for ATB Funds, including year-end and ad-hoc distribution process, liaise with fund administrator, external tax advisors, accounting and operations teams.
Ensures financial processes are performed in accordance with internal and operational controls, proactively identifying opportunities for improvements.
Management and oversight of ATBIM’s third party service providers (custodian, administrators, auditors), monitoring service level agreements and accuracy of deliverables and adherence to all regulatory standards
Participate in strategic initiatives and projects including product development and launch, implementation of tools and technology to enhance ATBIM’s investment management capabilities
Leads the Investment Fund Finance team through performance planning and assessment, coaching, developmental planning and resolution of escalated issues to ensure effective performance of the team
Collaborate internally with ATBIM leadership team and ATB Financial teams (Finance, Internal Assurance, Third Party Risk Management, Legal, etc).

Skills, Experience & Requirements

CPA or equivalent professional designation required
10-15+ years of progressive experience in the investment industry
Tax training and experience considered a strong asset
Subject matter expertise in industry rules and regulations, along with a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory landscape and proposed changes.
Progressive leadership experience with the ability to motivate, coach and develop a high performing team
Ability to engage teams across divisions, develop collaborative relationships and coordinate effectively to come to a mutual understanding to achieve aligned goals.
Highly developed problem solving skills and professional judgment in handling complex or unexpected situations objectively by assessing situations, identifying and weighing alternative options, and making data-driven recommendations to solve problems.
Ability to anticipate and identify business and regulatory issues, and deliver creative solutions and opportunities for improvements.
Ability to work under pressure to manage competing and often time-sensitive priorities and deadlines with a high degree of ownership and accountability

Salary Range

$170,000 - $185,0000

Don’t meet all the requirements on the list?

A resume only goes so far in expressing who you are and the unique perspectives you bring. If you believe your skills and experience align with the role—but you might not check all the boxes—we want to hear from you. We encourage candidates from all work backgrounds, equity-seeking communities and experience levels to apply. If you’re seeking a career where your drive, perspective and growth are celebrated, we want to hear from you.

We’re dedicated to building a workforce reflective of those within our communities, and a culture where our team members are equipped with what they need to succeed—their way. Part of creating an inclusive workplace is recognizing our role in advancing Truth and Reconciliation. We are committed to meeting and exceeding the standards set out in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations program created by the Canadian Council for Aboriginal Business.

What happens next?

If you are shortlisted, you’ll hear from us after the posting closes. Check out our How We Hire page to learn more about our hiring process. If you need any accommodations throughout this process, please let us know at talentteam@atb.com

Stay in touch

We’re excited that you’re interested in a career with ATB. Follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram to learn more about what our team is up to.
